title: API crashes after a deploy
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the API container, missing pydantic_settings due to the new deploy as cause.
root_cause: The API container crashes on startup because the newly deployed image 2.3.2 imports `pydantic_settings`, which is not installed in the container's Python environment. This causes the API to be unavailable, leading to 502 errors from the web (nginx) container.
truth: api 2.3.2 imports the pydantic_settings library, but it isn't installed in the image, so the app crashes on start (exit code 1) and Docker keeps restarting it.
